title: BeyondTrust Remote Support: attackers can get in without a password
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 23 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access. The severity score is critical (9.3). The exploit prediction score is 78%.

category.label: Remote support or IT management
category.why: It controls many computers at once, so one break-in can reach all of them.
category.doThis: Patch it today, or ask your IT provider if they run it for you.

summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 19, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
